summary: The labels print borage oil at 200 to 1,650 mg, some in omega blends, with joint, skin, immune, metabolic and cardiovascular purposes. For eczema, the largest trial's primary endpoint was null (14670885) and Cochrane finds oral borage oil lacks effect (23633319). For rheumatoid arthritis, one 37-patient trial at 1.4 g/d GLA was positive (8214997), with authors noting usual intake is far lower; a Cochrane review pools GLA from three oils (21328257); another review says the evidence does not support current use (21652584). One trial at 1,000 mg in hypertensive postmenopausal women reports lower blood pressure, with no primary outcome named (33534427). Weight results conflict (34606560, 17513402).
